name: JNW cube graph RACG
description: Right-angled Coxeter system whose defining graph is the 1-skeleton of a 3-cube, used by Jankiewicz-Norin-Wise as a legal-system example.

sourceRefs.citation: Kasia Jankiewicz, Sergey Norin, and Daniel T. Wise, Virtually Fibering Right-Angled Coxeter Groups, arXiv:1711.11505.
sourceRefs.locator: Section 2 for systems of moves and legal states; Section 5.a.1 for the cube graph example.
sourceRefs.notes: Section 5.a.1 uses the 1-skeleton of the 3-cube and the bipartition move system as a legal-system example.

notes: The generators are the binary vertices of the 3-cube.
The Coxeter entry is m=2 exactly when the corresponding cube vertices differ in one coordinate; otherwise it is infinite.
The JNW Legal-System Game preset preloads the JNW21 bipartition color-class moves and the legal initial state {v000, v001, v010, v101}.
The derived state quotient displays vertices as S_1, S_2, ... while the panel/inspector expands each name as a subset of cube vertices.
The app's JNW orbit and link diagnostics are browser checks for exploration, not an external certificate.
